bridge_chains.name: Biology -> Number Theory Pipeline
bridge_chains.description: Start from the biological metaphor of attractor basins, translate to fitness landscape, partition via topological levels, identify anomalous completeness values, and connect back to the core conjecture.

bridge_chains.name: Physics -> Computation Pipeline
bridge_chains.description: Start from statistical mechanics (thermodynamic formalism), use the spectral gap analogy to motivate ergodic mixing diagnostics, convert to a computational sieve, and deploy on GPU hardware.

bridge_chains.name: Information Theory -> p-adic Analysis Pipeline
bridge_chains.description: Start from Shannon entropy of trajectories, connect to ergodic mixing quality, bridge through renewal theory, enter p-adic analysis, and arrive at Tao's logarithmic density result.

bridge_chains.name: Statistics -> Biology Pipeline
bridge_chains.description: Start from extreme value statistics, connect to path record distributions, model as random walks, decompose via renewal theory, and arrive at the biological attractor basin metaphor.

bridge_chains.name: Full Cross-Domain Chain
bridge_chains.description: The complete pipeline from biological intuition through mathematical theory to computational implementation. Each step crosses a domain boundary.
